FIELDS.DESCRIPTION OF OPERATIONS: Harmony Instruments Sales & Repair specializes in the sales and repair of a wide variety of musical instruments, including guitars, pianos, brass, woodwinds, and percussion. Our operations focus on providing high-quality customer service, expert repairs, and a curated selection of instruments for musicians of all skill levels. Our retail space is designed to be welcoming and engaging, allowing customers to test instruments and receive personalized guidance from knowledgeable staff. We have a strict policy against renting out instruments, which helps us maintain a high standard of quality and reduces liability exposure. Our repair technicians are experienced and continually undergo training to stay updated with the latest techniques and trends in the industry. We take preventive measures seriously, ensuring that all high-value instruments are displayed securely and that we maintain comprehensive product liability coverage for all items sold. Committed to compliance with local business regulations, we ensure that our operations are safe, effective, and transparent.
